info.name: Get all templates in a project

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags used to filter templates.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of templates to return.

items.docs: Returns the metadata of every template in the project. This endpoint does not return the RenderScript source of each template; use `GET /templates/{id}` to retrieve a single template's source.

info.name: Get a template by its ID

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the template.

items.docs: Returns a single template including its RenderScript `source`, which describes the named elements that can be targeted by `modifications` when creating a render.
